title: Meta’s new Muse Image model can pull other Instagram users into AI photos
raw_excerpt: Meta is launching the first AI image generation model made by its Superintelligence Labs division. The Muse Image model now powers the image-making tools across the Meta AI app, Instagram, and WhatsApp, and it's coming soon to Facebook and Messenger, according to an announcement on Tuesday . It's part of the growing Muse family of AI models that replace Meta's Llama lineup. Alexandr Wang, who Meta hired to head up its Superintelligence Labs last year, says on Threads that Muse Image is "agentic," meaning it works with its Muse Spark large language model "to reason through your prompt, search the web, and plan before it generates." title: Anthropic is launching Claude Cowork on mobile and web
raw_excerpt: Starting Tuesday, Anthropic's Claude Cowork AI platform will be available on mobile and web for the first time. The expanded access is rolling out first to Max subscribers and coming to Claude users on other plans "in the coming weeks." Claude Cowork was previously only accessible through the Claude desktop app for macOS and Windows, but now users on iOS and Android can also use it. However, Anthropic says the "full experience" for Cowork will still be on the desktop app, including features like local file access. title: A global workspace in language models
raw_excerpt: Anthropic's new research paper introduces the concept of "J-space" in language models, revealed as internal neural patterns playing a unique role in Claude's processing. Emerging during training without explicit design, the J-space allows Claude to internally reason, modulate thoughts, and solve multi-step problems, distinguishing them from automatic processes. These patterns enable the monitoring of internal thoughts for AI misbehavior and provide insights into AI consciousness, suggesting a tangible distinction between deliberate and automatic decisions.
summary: Anthropic 发布新研究，揭示语言模型中的“J-space”概念——一种在训练中自发涌现的内部神经模式，在 Claude 的推理过程中扮演独特角色。J-space 使模型能够进行内部推理、调节思维并解决多步问题，区别于自动处理过程。该发现可用于监控 AI 的不当行为，并为理解 AI 意识提供了新视角。

title: The Download: your stake in OpenAI, and the Treasury’s AI warning

title: Hy3
raw_excerpt: Hy3 is a 295-billion-parameter Mixture-of-Experts model with 21 billion active parameters and 3.8 billion MTP layer parameters. Developed by Tencent, Hy3 outperforms similar-sized models and rivals flagship open-source models with two to five times more parameters. The full-sized model is available on Hugging Face. It is available for free on OpenRouter until July 21.
summary: 腾讯发布 Hy3，一个 2950 亿参数的混合专家模型，其中 210 亿为活跃参数。Hy3 在性能上超越同规模模型，并可匹敌参数多 2-5 倍的主流开源模型。完整模型已在 Hugging Face 开放，并在 OpenRouter 上免费提供至 7 月 21 日，为开源大模型生态注入强劲新力量。

title: Everyone Is Wrong About Open Source AI in the Enterprise
raw_excerpt: Decagon runs roughly 90% of its workloads on open-source models because small, heavily fine-tuned models deliver the latency and task-specific performance required for customer service agents. Most enterprise AI use cases remain early-stage, so companies favor frontier models that maximize flexibility and intelligence. As deployments mature and workflows stabilize, many production workloads will likely migrate from closed models to specialized open-source alternatives.
summary: Decagon 公司透露其约 90% 的工作负载运行在开源模型上，因为经过精细微调的小模型在延迟和任务特定性能上更优。文章指出，多数企业 AI 用例仍处早期，倾向于使用前沿模型；但随着部署成熟，许多生产工作负载将从闭源模型转向专门的开源替代方案，挑战了“企业必用闭源”的普遍认知。

title: From Hugging Face to Amazon SageMaker Studio in one click

title: Apple veteran's Chinese smart-glasses firm becomes unicorn as Tencent, Meituan fund rival to Meta
raw_excerpt: Even Realities Technology, founded by ex-Apple exec Will Wang, has reached unicorn status thanks to a $150 million funding round led by Tencent and Meituan.
summary: 由前苹果高管 Will Wang 创立的中国智能眼镜公司 Even Realities Technology 获得腾讯和美团领投的 1.5 亿美元融资，估值达到独角兽级别（10 亿美元）。该公司旨在挑战 Meta 在智能眼镜领域的地位，显示出中国资本和创业者对 AI 可穿戴设备赛道的强烈信心。
